baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 encodes an encounter with an object marked by the feminine suffix, and words 2-3 frame that encounter by yawm al-din.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fire-contact, a severe event-day, and recompense combine into a causal event: an assessed account comes due as direct exposure to its consequence.

activation_trace.role: Encountering fire and enduring its heat supplies the clause's direct physical event.
A severe event-day makes the temporal frame an occurrence that befalls rather than a bare calendar label.
Reckoning and recompense supply the reason the exposure occurs in this event.

changed_reading.before: They enter or burn in an unresolved 'it' on a named future day.
changed_reading.after: They undergo the consequence when reckoning itself arrives as the severe event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct yawm al-din at words 2-3 can join an open temporal span to din as debt, while word 1 supplies the cost of settlement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The day functions as the maturity of deferred liability: what remained on account reaches its term and is collected as experienced consequence.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time supplies the interval in which liability remains deferred.
Debt and credit turn din into an outstanding obligation with a settlement point.
The non-dominant mapped inventory independently supplies endured heat as the liability's collected cost.

changed_reading.before: Day of judgment is a generic title for a future tribunal.
changed_reading.after: It is the term at which deferred liability matures and becomes an experienced payment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 has a branch in which fire is used not only to burn but to turn and straighten a resistant object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Judicial heat can expose and force out crookedness, so the encounter carries a forensic straightening image alongside punitive burning.

activation_trace.role: Kindling, roasting, and straightening by fire supply heat as an operation upon resistant form.
Judgment and recompense make that fiery operation forensic rather than accidental.
The severe occasion provides the event in which hidden deformation is tested.

changed_reading.after: The fire also acts as a forensic heat that manifests and forcibly addresses crookedness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split inventory for word 1 contains a set snare, while words 2-3 specify the event at which recompense arrives.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object suffix can carry an imaginal capture relation: the consequence already set becomes effective when the event of recompense falls.

activation_trace.role: A set snare supplies capture as a secondary relational image for the fire encounter.
The event-day supplies the moment when the set consequence closes around its subjects.
Recompense identifies capture as consequence rather than arbitrary ambush.

changed_reading.before: They voluntarily approach a distant destination.
changed_reading.after: A consequence already set catches them when the event of recompense becomes present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence repeatedly breaches an ordered or concealing field and releases what it held. The focus fire-contact becomes the human endpoint of that decontainment: sheltered distance gives way to unavoidable exposure at reckoning.

activation_trace.role: Fire-contact supplies the final exposed condition to which the rupture sequence is inferred to lead.
Recompense anchors cosmic decontainment to the focus ayah's judicial event.
The elevated canopy that shades supplies the first containing field.
Opening and splitting convert the canopy from protection into breach.
Casting contents in dispersion supplies loss of ordered placement after breach.
A basin or ground that gathers water supplies a second containing field.
Wide rupture and outflow make containment fail explosively.
Concealment in a low place supplies the final hidden enclosure.
Turning earth and exposing what was buried completes the container-to-exposure pattern.

structural_cues: 82:1-4 repeat the same conditional opening while moving from canopy to stars to sea to grave.
Each pair moves an ordered or concealing domain toward rupture, dispersal, overflow, or exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies canopy, breach, scattering, held water, outflow, concealment, and exposure; I supply the arrow that this sequence culminates in the focus ayah's human exposure. A live alternative is that the signs are independent preliminaries without a shared containment mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a punishment isolated from the preceding cosmic signs.
changed_reading.after: Their fire-contact is the human-scale terminus of a world in which every shelter and concealment has opened.

context_deltas.mechanism: The debt model expands across temporal direction: whatever a self sent ahead and whatever it left for later becomes disclosed, so settlement gathers both immediate deeds and deferred residues.

activation_trace.role: Debt supplies the outstanding liability that the context temporally extends.
An open temporal span allows liabilities and effects to remain pending before maturity.
Endured heat supplies the experiential collection of the matured account.
Disclosure to the knower removes uncertainty about what belongs on the account.
Advancing something forward supplies deeds or effects already sent into the account.
Deferral to a later time supplies liabilities or effects that had not yet appeared.

structural_cues: 82:5 coordinates what was advanced and what was delayed around one self's eventual knowing.
The paired temporal directions prevent the account from being limited to immediately visible acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, advance, delay, debt, and a time span; I infer that advanced and delayed items are two temporal classes of one liability collected in the focus event. They may alternatively denote only deeds done early and late, without downstream effects.

changed_reading.before: Debt is only a loose synonym for judgment.
changed_reading.after: The fire encounter collects an account whose entries include both what was sent ahead and what remained deferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The subject was measured, completed, straightened, balanced, and composed under generous nurture, yet became deceived. Fire-straightening now reads as a forensic counter-operation that exposes the mismatch between given form and chosen deformation.

activation_trace.role: Straightening a resistant object by heat supplies the focus mechanism's operative image.
Judgment makes the heat a response to accountable mismatch rather than neutral manufacture.
Deception by what glitters but does not hold supplies the misreading that formation failed to prevent.
Repair, nurture, and completion identify the prior formative relation as constructive.
Measuring and proportioning supply a standard against which later deformation can appear.
Intrinsic straightness and completion activate the straightening dimension of the focus fire branch.
Setting a thing upright and balanced supplies the formative target condition.
Composing one thing into another presents the person as an intentionally assembled form.

structural_cues: The second-person object recurs through created, proportioned, balanced, and composed.
The formation sequence directly answers a question about being deceived by generous lordship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deception, nurture, measurement, straightness, balance, composition, and fire-straightening; I supply the arrow that judgmental heat reveals or counteracts chosen deformation. A live alternative is purely retributive heat, with formation serving only to establish responsibility.

changed_reading.before: Their heat is only externally imposed pain.
changed_reading.after: Their heat also tests and exposes how an intentionally balanced formation was bent by deception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same din later framing fire-contact is first denied as false. The focus reverses the mode of access: what was rejected propositionally becomes known through bodily encounter.

activation_trace.role: Direct fire-contact supplies embodied verification rather than further verbal argument.
Reckoning and recompense identify the reality that becomes experiential.
Contradiction of truth supplies the earlier epistemic posture that the focus reverses.
The repeated reckoning branch makes the denied object identical to the focus ayah's temporal frame.

structural_cues: The same definite din phrase occurs in the denial and in the focus temporal construction.
Addressed second-person denial becomes third-person bodily exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial of din followed by fire-contact on the day of din; I infer an argument-to-experience reversal. The alternative is a simple sequence of offense and penalty without an epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely reports the penalty for a separate act of disbelief.
changed_reading.after: The denied reckoning becomes self-authenticating as an experienced reality rather than a proposition they can continue to reject.

context_deltas.mechanism: Acts are guarded, inscribed in a form that obligates judgment, and known. The focus fire-contact is therefore not a freshly invented penalty but the execution or materialization of a conserved action-record.

activation_trace.role: Experienced heat supplies the enacted consequence of the preserved record.
Reckoning provides the transition from recorded evidence to requited outcome.
Guarding and preserving prevent the action-record from being lost.
Inscription that obligates a judgment turns observation into an enforceable record.
Disclosure to knowers supplies complete evidentiary access.
The production of an act identifies human doing as the content that is preserved and requited.

structural_cues: 82:10-12 forms a tight observer-writer-knower sequence ending in what the addressees do.
The focus follows the recorded-action block after the paired outcome classes are named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preservation, binding inscription, knowledge, action, reckoning, and heat; I infer a record-to-enactment arrow in which the experienced outcome realizes what was conserved. The record may alternatively serve only as courtroom evidence for an externally assigned sentence.

changed_reading.before: The fire is a new sentence imposed after evidence is reviewed.
changed_reading.after: The fire is also the enacted form of an action-record that was continuously preserved and made judicially binding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired locative states present two environments, while din can name habitual way. Truth carried into action and violated boundaries ripen into fitting habitats; the focus suffix is resolved by the immediately named blaze and turns static location into active exposure.

activation_trace.role: Entering or enduring fire turns the preceding locative state into an active relation.
Habit and customary condition allow the day to disclose a practiced orientation as settled state.
Truth that passes into speech and action supplies one lived orientation.
Suitability of place and pleasant dwelling supply an environment congruent with that orientation.
Deviation and tearing a protective boundary supply the contrary lived orientation.
Blazing and severe heat resolve the focus suffix's immediate referent and its matching environment.

structural_cues: 82:13 and 82:14 use parallel syntax to place two agent classes inside opposed states.
The feminine blaze noun immediately precedes the matching feminine object suffix in 82:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two symmetrical inhabitants, a fitting abode, boundary violation, blaze, habit, and fire-contact; I infer disposition-to-habitat congruence. The live alternative is categorical allocation by judgment with no claim that the outcome manifests prior habit.

changed_reading.before: An unresolved object is an externally assigned punishment on a future date.
changed_reading.after: They actively undergo the blaze named just before as a settled environment congruent with a practiced orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse negates absence from the same feminine referent. Fire-contact therefore extends beyond a punctiliar entry: no interval of concealment, withdrawal, or release interrupts presence to it.

activation_trace.role: Entering and enduring heat supply the contact whose continuity is tested by the next verse.
An open span of time permits the encounter to be durative rather than instantaneous.
Being hidden from sight supplies the absence that the syntax explicitly negates.

structural_cues: The feminine pronoun is carried directly from the focus object suffix into the following prepositional pronoun.
The following clause negates a state rather than merely repeating an entry verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire-contact, an open span, pronominal continuity, and negated absence; I infer uninterrupted exposure. The alternative is emphatic inescapability without a precise claim about every temporal interval.

changed_reading.before: They cross into the fire once at the judgment event.
changed_reading.after: They remain continuously present to its heat, unable even to recede into concealment or interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated question about knowing circles the same severe event. The split d-r-y inventory holds both knowledge and a water-whirlpool image, activating the day as an event that engulfs the external viewpoint rather than an object fully surveyed from outside.

activation_trace.role: Direct encounter with heat supplies experiential immersion in the event.
The severe occasion lets day denote the engulfing event rather than only its date.
Knowledge supplies the explicit question of cognitive access to the event.
The split mapping's turbulent whirlpool supplies an exploratory image for repeated conceptual circling and engulfment.
The repeated severe-event branch intensifies the event character of day.
Recompense keeps the exploratory turbulence anchored to the focus ayah's judicial frame.

structural_cues: The full knowing question is repeated, with the second occurrence introduced by a sequencing particle.
The repeated question names the same day phrase without yet supplying the final answer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated inquiry, knowledge, a split whirlpool image, severe event, and recompense; I supply the arrow from rhetorical circling to an event that engulfs the knower's external stance. The stronger alternative is simple magnification with no whirlpool mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The day is a definable date about which information can be stated from outside.
changed_reading.after: The focus encounter belongs to an event whose severity consumes the detached viewpoint and can finally be known only from within its operation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final verse removes every self-to-self channel of possession or disposal and assigns authority exclusively to God. Din's subjugation branch activates: fire-contact includes foreclosure of delegated agency, exchange, and rescue, not only thermal pain.

activation_trace.role: Fire-contact supplies the consequence from which no secondary agent can dispose or withdraw another.
Subjugation and possession activate judgment as the end of autonomous control.
Possession and power of disposal supply the capacity explicitly negated between selves.
The thing itself or self makes the negation exhaustive across one self's relation to another.
An independently identifiable thing gives the negation unrestricted object scope.
Authority and its possessor supply the exclusive governing power left after secondary control collapses.
The worshipped deity identifies the sole endpoint of the authority assignment.

structural_cues: The final sentence nests self, for self, and anything under a single negated ownership verb.
A following nominal clause relocates all authority exclusively after every secondary channel is denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated disposal, self-to-self scope, unrestricted object scope, exclusive authority, subjugation, and fire-contact; I infer that judgment closes every route of transfer or rescue. The alternative is a sovereignty formula that does not further specify the phenomenology of the fire encounter.

changed_reading.before: They suffer a penalty while ordinary relations of agency remain conceptually intact.
changed_reading.after: They meet the fire under total foreclosure of possession, exchange, intercession-like transfer, and self-directed escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the governing form at word 1 naturally selects fire-contact, not ritual prayer. It remains anchored in the same split root inventory and in din's submission plus the later worship branch; downstream prose should present it only as a dark relational echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 shares its split root inventory with prescribed worship, while word 3 also carries obedience and submission.

activation_trace.role: Prescribed bodily worship supplies the inverted posture echoed within the fire-bearing root.
Obedience and submission supply the relation that becomes compulsory at reckoning.
The earlier rejected way of submission supplies the reversal's prior refusal.
Worship and the worshipped one anchor the echo to the final exclusive authority.

changed_reading.before: They only undergo fire as physical punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their fire-contact also darkly echoes compulsory bodily submission after binding worship and obedience were denied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The snare and concealed-hunt images are branch-distant from the verbal surface, so this cannot serve as a lexical gloss. It remains valid as an anchored capture mechanism linking the focus root, negated disappearance, and a hunting branch in the split inquiry root; render it as an imaginal overlay qualified by 'as though'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The object-taking verb at word 1 has a root branch of set snares, and the event phrase supplies the point of closure.

activation_trace.role: The set snare supplies a capture geometry for the otherwise fiery object relation.
The event-day supplies the moment the latent capture becomes effective.
Concealment from sight supplies the escape mode explicitly denied after capture.
Concealment used in hunting supplies the prey-and-set-trap relation that activates the outlier.

changed_reading.before: They approach a visible punitive destination.
changed_reading.after: As though a long-set consequence closes around them, they cannot disappear from what has caught them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The second-place racer is an image branch, not the morphology or syntax of the focus verb. It remains anchored because the same root governs word 1 and the context supplies what was sent ahead plus a leader image; downstream prose should mark this only as sequence imagery for consequence overtaking its makers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 has a branch naming the racer immediately behind the leader, while the focus event is expressly one of recompense.

activation_trace.role: The second racer at the leader's haunches supplies immediate compelled following.
Recompense identifies the leading object as consequence rather than an arbitrary guide.
Precedence and an advanced position let deeds or their outcome be pictured as having gone ahead.
The advancing leader image completes the race relation while the verse denies the followers control.

changed_reading.before: The punished are isolated entrants into a stationary destination.
changed_reading.after: They appear as compelled followers arriving at the heels of the consequence their own advance had put before them.

strongest_changes: The opening breaches recast fire-contact as the terminal human exposure in a sequence of failed containments.
Debt, advance and delay, preservation, binding inscription, and known action turn the day into maturity and enactment of a conserved account.
Measured creation, straightening, balance, and composition activate a forensic fire-straightening reading alongside punishment.
The adjacent blaze and following negation of absence resolve the feminine object and make contact durative rather than a single entry.
The final collapse of self-to-self possession revises din into total foreclosure of secondary agency during the encounter.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root's split inventories kept fire, fire-straightening, snare, worship, and second-place following simultaneously live, while the split d-r-y cue added a contained whirlpool model to the repeated knowing questions. The context did not merely select one sense; it activated distinct material, legal, epistemic, spatial, and relational mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus clause alone leaves the feminine suffix unresolved; its identification with the preceding blaze depends on context.
The straightening and habit-to-habitat arrows are reader-supplied causal inferences, not directions stated by the packet.
Negated absence strongly supports inescapability, but uninterrupted duration is a further temporal inference.
The whirlpool, snare, worship, and racer readings are intentionally retained branch activations and must not be promoted to lexical translations.
